text:
maria: Heads-up: P99 TTFT jumped ~2x in eu-west-1 ~15:20 UTC. Grafana shows tokens/sec drop + KV cache hit rate falling. Anyone see a rollout around then?

sam: there was a deploy at 15:18 (release/v1.14.2). could be GC/memory pressure on hotshards.

deploy-bot: Deploy finished: release/v1.14.2 -> service/serving (eu-west-1) at 1800123478

priya: opening dashboard drill now — want p50/p95/p99 per-model + tokens/sec heatmap. @sam can you grep for eviction/ooms?

sam: on it. running: `kubectl logs -l app=serving --since=30m | grep -iE "evict|oomkill|killed"`

jamie: also seeing node cpu spike on gpu-pool-3 at ~15:19. autoscaler didn't add nodes (backoff?), possible scheduling queueing.

alex: prometheus queries to check: `sum(rate(tokens_processed[1m])) by (shard)` and `avg(kv_cache_hit_ratio)` overlay. our TTFT panels don't surface kv_cache dims atm.

maria: can someone add a transient panel: tokens/sec heatmap + overlay cache hit ratio for eu-west? want to correlate drop vs cache misses.

devops: I'll add a temp panel + an alert: p99 TTFT > 1200ms for 5m in eu-west -> page oncall.

infra-bot: Alert fired: TOKEN_SLO_P99_EUWEST at 1800123465, severity=warning

sam: found evictions: 7 OOMKilled in serving pods on node gpu-11 between 15:17-15:21. logs: https://logs.redwood.internal/serving/abcd (truncated)

priya: also spotted network flaps on nat-gw-2 in eu-west at 15:19 (BGP flap events). could amplify recovery delays for KV cache warming.

maria: proposed action: 1) rollback v1.14.2 in eu-west; 2) increase autoscaler aggressiveness for gpu pools; 3) add kv_cache_hit_ratio to token TTFT dashboards; 4) postmortem if rollback required. agree?

jamie: :thumbsup: starting rollback now.

deploy-bot: Started rollback: release/v1.14.2 -> v1.14.1 (eu-west) at 1800123490

maria: I'll open an incident ticket and add eng-sre + infra. adding runbook note to include KV cache metrics in first responder checklist.

sam: after rollback p99 dropped back to baseline in ~3m, tokens/sec recovered. saving drill graphs to /shared/slo-drills/1800123456

maria: thanks — follow-ups: (A) make dashboard template: tokens/sec x kv_cache_hit_ratio heatmap, (B) tune alert to include cache ratio to reduce noisy pages, (C) add autoscaler runbook step for hotshard scenarios. I'll own the runbook updates.

priya: will capture network/gateway events in incident ticket.

devops: added transient grafana panel + alert rule. panel URL: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/xyz/token-ttft-heatmap (will move to shared dashboards if approved)

alex: suggested prometheus rules to add to dashboards: `histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(token_latency_bucket[5m])) by (le, model))` + `avg_over_time(kv_cache_hit_ratio[5m])` overlay.

maria: good suggestion. pls add to dashboard template.

jamie: nice work everyone, closing the loop here. :white_check_mark:

maria: incident ticket created: INC-2026-1138. assigning postmortem owners.

sam: saved logs + screenshots in /shared/slo-drills/1800123456.

maria: thanks — will present TL;DR in next all-hands on infra slides.
